candidate.blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — client medication education and safe storage
candidate.blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — epinephrine auto-injector maintenance
candidate.educational_objective: Teach safe storage, visual inspection, and expiration replacement of an epinephrine auto-injector.

options.A: Keep the device indefinitely because epinephrine potency does not change over time.
options.B: Store the device in extreme heat or cold because temperature does not affect it.
options.C: Check the expiration date and solution appearance regularly and replace the device when indicated.
options.D: Use the device even if the solution is cloudy, discolored, or contains particles.

candidate.rationale: Epinephrine auto-injector labeling instructs clients to store the device at controlled room temperature, avoid extreme heat or cold, inspect the solution periodically, replace the unit if the solution is discolored, cloudy, or contains particles, and replace it before expiration. C is correct.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Store at room temperature, avoid extreme heat/cold, inspect solution, and replace for discoloration/cloudiness/particles or before expiration.
candidate.source_locator: Storage and Handling; Patient Information — How should I store epinephrine injection, USP auto-injector?
